comments.author: @maxthemagition
comments.text:
Until the AI can ask, then it is only a giant clever machine like an encyclopedia.
Without the ask it is only a machine.
What does the child say.....Why, who or what etc.
That is the child training itself.
The AI is trained by us.
It is not anything like us...yet!
I asked Bard if it could access the internet...yes it said.
I asked if it could listen to questions...yes it said.
Then I asked if it could listen to the radio....No.
The conversation went like this....

can you listen?
Yes, I can listen to you and process your requests. I can understand and respond to both spoken and written language. Please feel free to ask me anything or give me any instructions.

can you listen to the radio or TV?
I cannot directly listen to the radio or TV because I am a large language model, not a physical device. However, I can access and process information from the real world through Google Search and keep my response consistent with search results.

For example, if you ask me "What is playing on the radio right now?", I can use Google Search to find out what the current radio broadcast is and provide you with that information. I can also access and process information from streaming services, such as Spotify or YouTube Music, to provide you with information about what is currently playing on those platforms.

but you can listen via google
Yes, I can listen to the radio or TV via Google through Google Assistant, which is a virtual assistant that is available on many Google devices, such as smartphones, smart speakers, and smart displays. Google Assistant can access and process information from the real world through Google Search and keep my response consistent with search results.
For example, if you ask me "What is playing on the radio right now?", Google Assistant can use Google Search to find out what the current radio broadcast is and provide you with that information. Google Assistant can also access and process information from streaming services, such as Spotify or YouTube Music, to provide you with information about what is currently playing on those platforms.
To use Google Assistant to listen to the radio or TV, you can say the following commands:
"Hey Google, play the radio."
"Hey Google, what is playing on the TV right now?"
"Hey Google, play [radio station name] on Spotify."
"Hey Google, play [TV show name] on YouTube."
Google Assistant will then start playing the radio or TV show that you requested.

so why don't you?
I do not have the same capabilities as Google Assistant because I am a large language model, not a virtual assistant. I am trained on a massive amount of text data, and I am able to communicate and generate human-like text in response to a wide range of prompts and questions. However, I am not able to access and process information from the real world in the same way that Google Assistant can.

Google Assistant is a virtual assistant that is designed to be able to interact with the real world in a more natural and intuitive way. It can understand and respond to spoken and written language, and it can also access and process information from the real world through Google Search and other Google services. This allows Google Assistant to do things that I cannot do, such as play music or TV shows, control smart home devices, and make appointments.

I am still under development, and I am constantly learning new things. It is possible that in the future I will be able to access and process information from the real world in the same way that Google Assistant can. However, for now, I am not able to do this.

So you cannot ask?
That is correct. I cannot directly ask questions of a person or a system. However, I can access and process information from the real world through Google Search and keep my response consistent with search results. This allows me to provide you with information that is relevant to your query, even if I cannot directly ask the question myself.

For example, if you ask me "What is the capital of France?", I can use Google Search to find the answer to this question and provide it to you. I can also access and process information from other sources, such as books, articles, and websites, to provide you with more comprehensive and informative answers to your questions.

Please let me know if you have any other questions.

why can you not ask?

There are a few reasons why I cannot directly ask questions of a person or a system.

Technical limitations: I am a large language model, and I am not designed to interact with the real world in the same way that a human can. I can only process information that is provided to me in text format, and I cannot directly interact with physical objects or people.

Data limitations: I am trained on a massive dataset of text and code, but this dataset does not include information about the real world. This means that I may not have the knowledge or understanding necessary to ask meaningful questions.

Social limitations: Asking questions can be a complex social interaction, and it requires an understanding of social norms and conventions. I am not able to understand these social norms and conventions, and I may ask questions that are rude, offensive, or inappropriate.

Despite these limitations, I am constantly learning and improving. It is possible that in the future I will be able to ask questions in a more natural and effective way. However, for now, I am not able to do this.
